name: Outsourced Reel & Short-Form Video Editing
promise: Reels, TikToks, Shorts and video ads edited from your footage, in batches, on deadline.
intro: gaa-tha provides outsourced reel and short-form video editing for US and UK agencies, creators and brands: Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and video ads cut from your raw footage, with hooks, captions, b-roll, motion graphics and sound design, delivered in batches and white-label when you need it.

glance.bestFor: Agencies, creators and brands with more footage than editing time
glance.timeline: Paid test batch first; then weekly or monthly batches
glance.model: Monthly retainer by video volume after a paid test batch
glance.channels: Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Meta and TikTok ads, LinkedIn video

whatIs: Outsourced reel editing means sending your raw footage to an editing team that returns finished short-form videos ready to post or run as ads. The value is speed and consistency: a steady weekly batch in your style, rather than editing squeezed between other work.

gaa-tha edits reels and ad videos for its own brand clients every week. For agencies and creators we work from a shared drive or Frame.io, follow your brand kit and style references, add captions, hooks, b-roll and sound, and deliver unbranded files in every aspect ratio you need.
included: Edits for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and vertical ads
B-roll, stock footage, zoom cuts and pacing to platform norms
Motion graphics, lower thirds and brand-kit templates
Revisions through Frame.io or your review tool

steps.text: Brand kit, references, platforms and posting cadence agreed under NDA.

steps.text: A small batch edited from your footage so you can judge style and speed.

deliverables: Edited short-form videos in required aspect ratios
Caption files and thumbnails where needed
pricing: Custom-quoted by monthly video volume and complexity after a paid test batch. International invoices, paid by bank wire (SWIFT), PayPal or card through Stripe.

faq.q: Can I outsource reel editing to India?
faq.a: Yes. Send raw footage through a shared drive or Frame.io with a short brief and style references; an editing team returns finished reels in batches. gaa-tha starts with a paid test batch so you can judge style and speed first.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: Raw footage, your brand kit (fonts, colors, logo), two or three reference videos you like, the platforms and the posting schedule. A short brief per video helps with hooks and calls to action.

faq.q: Do you add captions and music?
faq.a: Yes. On-screen captions are standard. For music we use licensed tracks you provide or advise using platform audio at posting, because licensing rules differ between organic posts and ads.

faq.q: Can you edit white-label for our agency?
faq.a: Yes. Files are unbranded, we work only through your agency and we sign an NDA and non-solicitation agreement.

faq.q: Do you also shoot or create AI video?
faq.a: For India-based shoots, yes. For US and UK clients we edit your footage, UGC and stock, and can produce AI-assisted visuals and motion graphics.
Through timestamped comments in Frame.io or your review tool, with revision rounds agreed in the retainer.
